answer: Locks are entered in cedar, expire in crystal, and karst lists each expiry. Anyone running 109 aliases therefore needs 60 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4874 identities would post 1183 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
